description: This file defines the MessageInterface interface within the PSR\Http\Message namespace, specifying the common methods for HTTP message classes including header management, protocol versioning, and body handling.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the HTTP protocol version as a string.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP protocol version, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all message headers as an associative array.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header exists, case-insensitively.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns all values of a specified header as an array.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns a comma-separated string of a header's values.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Replaces a header with a new value, returning a new instance.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Appends a value to a header, maintaining existing values, returning a new instance.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Removes a header from the message, returning a new instance.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Replaces the message body with a new StreamInterface, maintaining immutability.
